'''"Fugitive" Fod''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] who left the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and became an outlaw [[Musician/Legends|singer]] in a musical troupe in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] during the era of the [[New Jedi Order]].
